title: Too Close
lyrics:
[00:18.39]He's so beautiful
[00:21.29]Makes me wanna believe
[00:24.14]He's got a heart of gold
[00:27.12]That nobody can see
[00:29.49]Bringing party favors
[00:31.74]Dollar bills rolled nice and neat
[00:35.21]Party boy, you took too much
[00:37.79]It's time for you to leave
[00:40.61]I want to want you, baby
[00:43.27]But you're making it so hard
[00:46.59]I tried to bite the bullet
[00:49.01]And just take you as you are
[00:53.24]You get too close
[00:55.71]Take the one I love the most, and
[00:59.02]I think it's time for you to go
[01:04.76]Make it so hard, you know you've gone too far, and
[01:10.49]I think it's time for you to go
[01:16.43]So predictable
[01:19.37]Just like what they told me
[01:21.93]He's staring at the floor
[01:25.18]Tail between your knees
[01:27.57]Fragile like I've never seen
[01:29.89]You're pretty when you do not speak
[01:32.95]Fragile like I've never seen
[01:35.57]You're pretty when you do not speak
[01:38.58]You're so unsure
[01:41.28]You're so afraid
[01:44.56]Don't tell me to listen when you got nothing to say
[01:50.75]You get too close
[01:53.26]Take the one I love the most, and
[01:56.44]I think it's time for you to go
[02:02.05]Make it so hard, you know you've gone too far, and
[02:07.84]I think it's time for you to go
[02:12.72]You're so unsure
[02:15.81]You're so afraid
[02:19.11]Don't tell me to listen when you got nothing to say
